name: DemoChemistry
title: Demo Chemistry (C# data stage)
author: factorio-csharp
description: A small chemistry chain written entirely in C#: a coolant that is a recoloured water, a machine with its own rendered graphics, a resin and a pellet, and the recipes that make all of it obtainable in a normal game. The data stage is C# evaluated at build time and emitted as data.lua; the runtime stage is C# compiled to control.lua.
